# dist/

What the tacit-icons package installs, as Tacit uses it on 2026-10-08:

- `cursor/masks.bin`: the cursor shapes (cursors.py), which `paint.py` (installed as tacit-cursor-paint) colours from the wallpaper
- `icons/Tacit`: the cursor theme painted in the colours of the day it was taken, the default before a person's own is painted
- `icons/Quiet`: the folder icons in the shell's glyphs; everything else inherits Tela-circle-purple-dark
